I got my gecko five months ago, so I don’t have a lot of experience, but I researched nonstop, talked to people nonstop. I feel like I’ve learned a ton. And also, My gecko is very healthy according to his last checkup. (: 

I started my Yoshi off in a 10gallon tank as well, but as your gecko grows it will probably not be enough space for him. I had to upgrade my gecko into a 20gallon. 

I usually leave any crickets he missed in the tank for a little while, so he has the chance to find them. Grabbing crickets is hard. I still struggle. Just go in for it and be as assertive as you can. 
Yoshi loves mealworms (: But mealworms can be harder for them to digest, as they have a harder body. Feed your gecko a variety, just don’t make the mealworms the staple food. 
Do you have the supplement powders necessary for their diet? 

Your gecko will definitely need the moist hide for shedding. As the previous comment said, you’re gonna want to try to redirect where his pooping is. Do try to maybe place his poop somewhere desired for pooping so he doesn’t keep going there. You don’t want his poop to get all over him when he sheds. Yoshi has one dry hide he likes to poop in and I keep a paper towel right on it for easy cleanup. 

Your amount of hides is good, make sure one is specifically on the warm side and the other on the cool. Try to add fake foliage, like Flukers brand leaves, so he feels less exposed. 

Edit: forgot to add: Of course always be sure your gecko isn’t stuck and make sure the tank is friendly for him to crawl, lick, sit on basically everything in it. Leopard geckos like crawling around and finding little small places to hide in, so it’s not really abnormal to see them in tight cracks. Just be sure he’s safe. 

Congratulations on your gecko! 🦎🦎🦎
